scheme_name_english: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
category: Rural Livelihoods / Employment / Self Help Groups
department: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India
beneficiary: Rural poor households, especially women organised into Self Help Groups and their federations
benefits: Formation and strengthening of Self Help Groups
Financial inclusion and access to credit
Livelihood promotion and support for rural enterprises
eligibility: Rural poor households and eligible community members are organised through state and local implementation structures, with priority to women-led Self Help Groups.
required_documents: Documents vary by SHG formation, bank linkage, livelihood activity and local implementation process.
application_process: Contact the State Rural Livelihoods Mission, district/block rural livelihood mission office or participating Self Help Group/community institution.
application_mode: SHG / Block / District Rural Livelihood Mission
source_type: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India
